title: n8n Respond to Webhook node fails in queue mode when the response is larger than 64 MiB
symptoms: Respond to Webhook node errors on a large payload from a worker in queue mode
Large database result sets or CSV/XML responses fail while small ones succeed
cause: In queue mode the worker sends the webhook response back through Redis to the main or webhook instance. n8n caps this at 64 MiB by default (N8N_WEBHOOK_RESPONSE_RELAY_SIZE_MAX), and larger responses fail the node.
fix: On n8n 2.34 or later, upgrade main and webhook instances first, then set N8N_WEBHOOK_RESPONSE_RELAY_OFFLOAD_ENABLED=true on workers. This requires a binary data mode other than default and storage all instances can read (s3 or azure recommended). Or shrink the response.
affected: n8n queue mode before 2.34 (no offload option); offload requires main instances on 2.34.0+
